name: Auranet Page and Theme Builder
author: Auranet Informática

sections.description:
Auranet Page and Theme Builder is a free visual builder for WordPress by Auranet.

  • Drag-and-drop style editing for pages and posts
  • Theme Builder for header, footer and single templates
  • Template library and design kits
  • Responsive controls and modern widgets
  • Optional footer credit you can enable or disable freely (off by default)

All features included in this plugin are free and fully functional. Nothing is locked behind a license key.

Optional footer credit

In Settings you may optionally show a “Powered by Auranet Builder” link in the public footer. This is opt-in and never required to use any feature.

External services

Google Maps (optional widget)

The Google Maps widget embeds a map using Google’s public maps embed (https://maps.google.com/…) only when you place the Maps widget and set an address. The address text is sent as a query parameter in the embed URL when the page is viewed.

  • Service: Google Maps Embed
  • Data sent: the address string you configured in the widget
  • When: whenever a visitor loads a page that contains the Maps widget
  • Google Terms of Service
  • Google Privacy Policy

No other remote scripts or image CDNs are required for the plugin to work.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate Auranet Page and Theme Builder.
  3. Open Auranet Builder in the admin menu and edit a page, or use Theme Builder for header/footer.
sections.faq:
Is everything free?

Yes. All features in this plugin are free and fully functional.

Do I need a license key?

No. A license key is not required for any feature on WordPress.org.

Does the plugin load remote assets?

Default widget placeholders use empty/local values. The optional Google Maps widget embeds maps.google.com when used (documented above).
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • Gallery slider: autoplay option (interval) for front and editor preview
  • Spacing controls: independent top/right/bottom/left margin and padding
  • Image / accordion / media: focal-point control for object-position
  • Header Theme Builder: responsive mobile chrome and sticky behaviour fixes
  • Layout: full-width sections and width 100% without max-width blocking expand
  • Style engine parity: better desktop/tablet/mobile CSS for containers and widgets
  • Editor shell: selection, props panel and live preview stability improvements

1.0.3

  • Document REST update requires edit_theme_options when saving site-wide popups or homepage flag
  • Defense-in-depth: only sync global popups / home settings when the user has those caps

1.0.2

  • Remove arbitrary custom CSS storage (use Appearance → Customize → Additional CSS)
  • Stronger REST permissions for globals and theme parts (edit_theme_options)
  • Construction mode CSS via wp_enqueue_style / static file
  • Safer inline CSS/JS helpers; unique aptb_ option/meta/hook prefixes

1.0.1

  • WordPress.org review compliance: rename, free features only, enqueue assets, sanitization, external service docs

1.0.0

  • Initial submission package
